name: Camping Ötztal Längenfeld
beschreibung: The Campingplatz Ötztal Längenfeld is located in Längenfeld in the Ötztal. It offers pitches for motorhomes, caravans and tents. The sanitary facilities are modern and heated. A bread roll service is available daily. Nearby are the Stuibenfall waterfalls and the Ötztaler Therme. The region is ideal for hiking in summer and skiing in winter. A restaurant on the site serves regional dishes.
